entities.summary: The Suzhou Olympic Sports Centre is a sports complex located in the Suzhou Industrial Park, Jiangsu, China. The complex is composed of multiple buildings and facilities, including a stadium, a gymnasium, a natatorium and a business center. It was officially opened in January 2019.
